editorial:
Ever wondered what happens when a piece of old art comes to life in the weirdest way possible? You are stepping into a world inspired by a famous Japanese print, where a young girl finds herself in a very strange and risky relationship with two octopuses. It is not your typical love story. The vibe is a mix of beauty and a kind of scary attraction that makes you feel uneasy but keeps you watching. You will feel the tension as the boundaries between human and animal blur, creating a mood that is both dreamy and a bit creepy.

The acting is surprisingly soft and natural, which makes the bizarre plot feel more real. While the pacing is slow at times, the visuals are stunning and really capture that old-school art style. If you like movies that push buttons and try something totally new, you will love this. You should definitely check it out by streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a wild ride that you won't forget easily.
endingExplained: The story ends with the girl fully giving in to her strange bond with the creatures. Instead of fighting the scary side of her attraction, she accepts her fate. She becomes completely entwined with the octopuses, losing her human life to stay with them in the deep. It is a sad but peaceful wrap-up that shows how her obsession finally took over her whole world, leaving her trapped in a watery embrace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves unconventional art films and strange romance.
